name: organism-composition
title: Organism composition
description: Six useful compositions made from persistent Cojeev base components, with organic assembly and native controls.

props.name: assembled
props.description: False separates the native roots into floating silhouettes. Quiet mode stays usable.

props.name: particleCount
props.description: Decorative seed count for an assembly scene. Zero leaves a plain usable composition.

props.name: items
props.description: Up to four task or dock items.

props.name: durationSeconds
props.description: Real local session length, clamped to 1–86400 seconds. Changing it resets the session.
